title: fix(fields,plugin-detail,plugin-grid,app-shell,i18n): read-only booleans, the boolean list face and the Home greeting follow the locale (objectui#11689)
body:
Fixes #11689

Clause-②: yes

Read-only boolean values, the boolean list face and the Home greeting now take their words and punctuation from the language packs. Under zh-CN the record-detail highlights strip read the English word beside a translated label (the card's "Email Verified" sighting), the list face's status badge read "LABEL — Off", and Home joined the night greeting to the name with an ASCII comma and period. All of them now read in the session language; en is unchanged.

The file surface is the claim's, widened by claim amendment 6019561490 (the two family sites seat 1 recorded in 6019099345), plus the producer the measurement found (see "Where the sighting came from").

## Read-only boolean words: the existing `common.yes` / `common.no`

| Surface | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|
| `BooleanField` readonly branch | literal `'Yes'` / `'No'` | `useBooleanValueLabel()` |
| `FormulaField` with `returnType: 'boolean'` | literal | `useBooleanValueLabel()` |
| `renderLookupColumnValue` plain-text fallback | literal | `BooleanValueText` (same hook; the function cannot call a hook itself, and both callers render what it returns) |
| record-detail highlights chip (`HeaderHighlight`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`) | JSX text `Yes` / `No` | `useBooleanValueLabel()`, exported from `@object-ui/fields` |

**Why `common.yes` / `common.no` and no new key.** The packs carry three `yes` rows. `common.yes` / `common.no` is the pair whose meaning is "the value of a boolean": its one existing reader, app-shell's audit-history display, draws a boolean field's old and new value with it. `grid.yes` / `grid.no` belong to `ObjectGrid`'s own toolbar bundle (group header, bulk-action dialog), and `lookup.yes` is the record picker's filter-checkbox caption with no `no` half. No confirm dialog reads `common.yes`.

**One rule, one home.** `useBooleanValueLabel` (new file `packages/fields/src/widgets/booleanValueLabel.tsx`) is the only place that maps a boolean to its key; every drawer above calls it. `useFieldTranslation`'s defaults table carries both rows with the en values, so a field rendered without an `I18nProvider` still says Yes / No.

**Where the sighting came from.** `sys_user` lists `email_verified` among its `highlightFields`, and the highlights chip spelled the words as JSX text, which is why a plain `'Yes'` grep in `packages/fields` and `packages/components` did not find it. The record body's own row draws a boolean through `BooleanCellRenderer` (a checkbox, no word). So the fix also lands in `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, as the order allows for a producer found elsewhere.

## The boolean list face (`BooleanCellRenderer`): three new keys under `fields.boolean`

| Word | Key | en | zh |
|---|---|---|---|
| status badge for `false` on a status-named column | `fields.boolean.offBadge` | `{{label}} — Off` | `{{label}} — 已关闭` |
| completion indicator, `true` (accessible name) | `fields.boolean.completed` | `Completed` | `已完成` |
| completion indicator, `false` (accessible name) | `fields.boolean.notCompleted` | `Not completed` | `未完成` |

The badge is one interpolated sentence, so a locale can reorder the label and the word. Read through the same hook and defaults table as the Yes / No words (`useFieldTranslation`). Reuse was considered and refused: `packagedAutomation.off` is a console page's switch state, `dashboard.config.refresh.off` the auto-refresh setting, `chatbot.toolState.completed` an AI tool call's state. None of them names a field value. The zh value follows the pack's existing word for off (`packagedAutomation.off`).

## The grid hands the face the header's label

`ObjectGrid` handed the cell face the authored field label while its header printed the translated one (`resolveFieldLabel`). So under a non-en pack the badge sat under a translated header and named the column in the authored language. Every schema-backed path now hands the face the `header` it already resolved, with no second copy of the label rule: object-shaped columns, string columns, inline-data columns, and the columns generated from the schema. The last is not one of the three sites the amendment names; it is the same one-line label handoff. The authored-label guard stays, so an unlabelled field keeps the face's own fallback.

## Greeting joiners: two new keys

`home.greetingSeparator` (the comma before the name, rendered only when there is a name) and `home.greetingEnd` (the closing mark). I chose a joiner pair over `Trans` component interpolation: the markup stays as it is, so the name keeps its own `text-primary` span and the closing mark its muted one, and no pack carries component markup.

| Pack | separator | end |
|---|---|---|
| zh | `，` | `。` |
| ja | `、` | `。` |
| ar | `، ` | `.` |
| en, de, fr, es, pt, ru, ko | `, ` | `.` |

zh-CN now reads "夜深了，Dev Admin。"; en still reads "Working late, Dev Admin.".

## Public surface (the `Clause-②` reading)

- Built `@object-ui/i18n` `dist/locales/en.d.ts`, base `c910630` against head `550037f`: five members added, nothing else moved. They are `fields.boolean` with `offBadge: "{{label}} — Off"`, `completed: "Completed"` and `notCompleted: "Not completed"`, plus `home.greetingSeparator: ", "` and `home.greetingEnd: "."`. The `TranslationKeys` type derived from `en` gains the same five.
- `@object-ui/fields`: one new export, `useBooleanValueLabel`, with its type `BooleanValueLabel`. `BooleanValueText` stays internal.
- Changeset `.changeset/11689-boolean-greeting-locale.md`: `minor` for fields, plugin-detail, plugin-grid, app-shell and i18n.

## Pins (all under a real `I18nProvider` over the real packs; en and provider-less are the controls)

- `packages/fields/src/__tests__/booleanValueLabel.locale-11689.test.tsx` has two parts. The three drawers: zh 是 / 否, en Yes / No, every pack's own `common.yes` / `common.no`, provider-less Yes / No. Then `BooleanCellRenderer`: zh badge `启用 — 已关闭`, zh accessible names, en unchanged, every pack, provider-less.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/HeaderHighlight.booleanLocale-11689.test.tsx`: zh chips 是 / 否, en and provider-less Yes / No.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/__tests__/HomePage.greetingLocale-11689.test.tsx`: the real `HomePage` at 02:30 local. zh heading `夜深了，Dev Admin。`, en `Working late, Dev Admin.`, the name keeps its coloured span, and with no name only the closing mark appears.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.cellFaceLabel-11689.test.tsx`: object-shaped, string and generated columns. zh badge `启用 — 已关闭` under a `启用` header, en `Active — Off`.
- `packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.cellFaces-11686.test.tsx` (from objectui#11721, merged here at `a58626c`): its zh pin is re-judged to the whole translated badge, `启用 — 已关闭`.

## Ablation (one-shot, at `550037f`, four legs, each restore proven)

Each leg went through `ablation-replace.mjs`, which checks the anchor hit, the marker count and that the blob changed, then restores and proves blob == HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`. After all four legs, `git status --porcelain` was empty. The tests resolve the packages through the vitest source alias, so no `dist` step was involved.

| Leg | Mutation | Predicted | Observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `useBooleanValueLabel` returns the English literals | zh and every-pack cases red in the three drawers and the chip, en and provider-less green | 7 failed, 13 passed (20) |
| 2 | greeting separator back to ASCII `', '` | only the zh full-width case red | 1 failed, 3 passed (4) |
| 3 | `BooleanCellRenderer` badge back to the literal `— Off` | fields zh and every-pack badge cases, three grid zh cases and the tree zh pin red | 6 failed, 22 passed (28) |
| 4 | grid string and inline paths hand the authored label again | only the string-columns zh case red (`Active — 已关闭` received) | 1 failed, 5 passed (6) |

| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/` | 235 files passed, 1 skipped |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/ packages/i18n/` | 321 files passed, 1 skipped |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/ packages/plugin-tree/` | 211 files passed |
| the root i18n suites in `scripts/__tests__`: defaults-population-parity-7904, check-i18n-call-site-keys, check-i18n-en-drift, check-i18n-dead-keys, placeholder-spelling-parity | 5 files passed |
| app-shell, narrowed: `console/home/`, the defaults-maps mirror, audit-history display, the three `AppContent` suites that mount `HomePage`, and `RecordDetailView.lookupDependsOn-7190` | 23 files passed |
| `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only), `check:i18n-designer-parity` | exit 0 |
| `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims` (report-only; the one paragraph it names, in the 11659 changeset, stays true), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-presence` | exit 0 |
| `check:test-path-roots`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:self-import`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape` | exit 0 |
| `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the diff | NOT GOVERNED |

The app-shell run is a declared narrowing: the full package has more than a thousand test files, and CI runs them sharded.

## Acceptance notes (observed, not changed here, nothing filed)

- More hard-coded English boolean words outside this surface: `ObjectGantt`'s tooltip boolean branch, `PropertyEditor`'s boolean caption (plugin-designer), and `deriveMasterDetail`'s `optionsFor` labels for a boolean column (plugin-form). Raw `true` / `false` text also appears in `ConcurrentUpdateDialog` and `HistoryTimeline` (plugin-detail) and in `record-picker` (components).
- The highlights chip and the boolean `FormulaField` still read the value by truthiness, so a null boolean highlight draws the "No" chip. That is the defect class the readonly `BooleanField` and `BooleanCellRenderer` were ruled on; it is not judged here.
- The ko pack spells `common.no` `아니오` and `grid.no` `아니요`.
- The grid's inline-data path prints the authored label in its header, without `resolveFieldLabel`. The face now matches that header.
- The grid's generated-columns path hands the face the raw schema def. A def without its own `name` never reaches the boolean face's status and completion name tests.
- app-shell's audit-history display keeps its own `common.yes` / `common.no` selection through its `ctx.t`, with its own truthiness.
